originStory.title: Why I Started Coaching
originStory.story: After years of creating courses and kits, I kept receiving the same message: 'Your content is great, but I'm still stuck on my specific situation.' I realized that even the best courses can't diagnose individual challenges. Some people don't need more information; they need someone to look at their mess and help them see the patterns. Someone who's actually practiced this for decades. That's why I started coaching: not to replace self-learning, but to accelerate it.

creatorJourney.title: 20+ Years of Real Practice
creatorJourney.subtitle: Not Theory. Lived Experience.
creatorJourney.story: I've been passionate about Knowledge Management since the early 2000s. As a software architect, author, content creator, and entrepreneur, all while raising three kids, I needed systems that actually work under pressure. I've used dozens of tools, tested many methods, and refined my approach through practice. I've published **10,000+ notes**, written books, and helped hundreds of people build their own systems.

Had to build systems that work with a busy family life

methodology.title: How I Coach
methodology.subtitle: Principles, Not Copy-Paste

steps.title: Listen and Diagnose
steps.description: I start by understanding your situation: your work, your goals, your challenges, and what you've already tried. No assumptions.

steps.title: Apply First Principles
steps.description: Instead of prescribing my system, I help you understand WHY certain approaches work. This lets you build something that fits your reality.

steps.title: Design Your System
steps.description: Together, we sketch out your system. Not a copy of mine. Principles that work whether you use `Obsidian`, `Notion`, or anything else.

steps.title: Create Action Plan
steps.description: You leave with specific next steps. Not vague advice. Concrete actions you can take today.

methodology.philosophy: I don't believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. The best PKM system is one designed for your life, built on proven principles, and simple enough that you'll actually use it.
